envelope.description: The daemon's built-in graph tools apply the same guard and filtering

body.title: The daemon's built-in graph tools apply the same guard and filtering
body.summary: src/daemon/tools/builtins/graph/index.ts: graph_entity, graph_callers, graph_callees and graph_query fail with the RepoIndexingError message ('repo-indexing' first) for a named entity (or any root) under index, and leave such entities out of traversal and closure results; graph_search skips repositories under index as search.query does. Reuses the guard of t12 and the filtering of t13. Grounding: src/daemon/tools/builtins/graph/index.ts defines graph_entity (:73), graph_search (:113), graph_callers and graph_callees (one factory, :157-167) and graph_query (:308).
acceptanceChecks: graph_entity, graph_callers, graph_callees and graph_query about a repository under index fail with 'repo-indexing'.
graph_search leaves a repository under index out; graph_query from a ready repository leaves out the entities of a repository under index.

tests.name: the built-in graph tools (graph_entity, graph_callers, graph_callees, graph_query) about a repository under index fail with 'repo-indexing'; graph_search leaves such a repository out
graph_query from a ready repository whose closure reaches a repository under index leaves that repository's entities out
